Bloodline replaces non-scoring haste: 85 HP feeds the equipped Riftmaker HP-to-AP conversion. Keep conditional native modifiers separate from rune proc damage. Arcane Comet: Comet is separate damage and can miss; target movement and range affect the comparison. Manaflow Band: Earned maximum mana/resource utility; only actual mana conversions can turn it into offensive stats. Absolute Focus: Adaptive stats only while owner stays above 70% HP (starts at 100%). Gathering Storm: Fixed minute-30 adaptive stats (or the authored time), never an infinite-time ceiling. Legend: Bloodline: Exactly 15 earned stacks grant 85 HP, which equipped Riftmaker converts into AP; native output gains only through its actual HP/AP coefficients, not life-steal healing. Coup de Grace: Eligible non-true damage only below 40% victim HP; not active on a healthy first hit.

Rune preparation: Gathering Storm fixed at authored minute 30; no extra game time. Manaflow: log ten actually earned procs if using its 250 bonus mana; never invent full stacks or mana-to-AP conversion. Bloodline benchmark: exactly 15 legitimately earned Legend stacks before measurement, granting 85 max HP. Read actual HP/AP after equipped conversions; with fewer stacks credit no completion HP. No extra attacks are added to the scored action budget.

Rune comparison: Compare a real prepared Conqueror page versus the selected page without changing target defenses, HP, earned item stacks, rank or time. Additional rune preparation must be its own recorded trial. Compare First Strike or a damage keystone only in a separately reported total-hit result; proc damage is outside the named native packet.

Stat shards: Offense adaptive force feeds only the actual AD/AP coefficient and uses real adaptive-type conversion. Flex adaptive force targets the stated AD/AP coefficient. Defense scaling health is 180 HP at level 18, rather than the old 65-HP shard.

builds.summary: Investigate high one fully grown Caretaker's Shrine heal output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.

builds.hypothesis: The mature shrine heals 50/87.5/125/162.5/200 + 0.7 AP after five seconds. An immature shrine instead heals 25/50/75/100/125 + 0.4 AP. These are alternative states, not two additive heals; movement speed is separate.
